items.claim: Fluent 2 typography defines a structured type ramp and encourages sentence case and readable hierarchy across interface text.
Fluent layout guidance uses a global spacing ramp centered on compact repeatable increments and adapts layout for responsive and touch contexts.
items.notes: Supports adaptive density rather than one fixed spacing mode.

items.claim: Fluent color guidance separates neutral, shared, and brand palettes and assigns color by role rather than by decorative preference.
The system's neutral visual tone is valuable because it allows many product types to coexist, but strong product identity must come from content, structure, and bounded brand expression.
